after.event: Wei Guan is named as Grand Guardian and father of Ting in the assignment list; no calendar date is stated for Wei Guan.

changes.reason: s0205 使太保衛瓘息庭…與太子游處 dates the sending of Wei Ting in 元康元年. 太保衛瓘 is only the 息-formula father, so the year is not Wei Guan’s event; keep the naming as an undated attestation.

changes.reason: s0205 司空泰息略 names Sima Tai only as Lue’s father. The 元康元年 date belongs to the son’s assignment; keep Tai’s naming as an undated attestation.

changes.reason: s0205 尚書令華暠息恆 names Hua Gao only as Heng’s father. 元康元年 dates Heng’s assignment; keep Gao’s naming as an undated attestation.

s0131 乃誅劉振、孫慮、程據等 records Cheng Ju’s execution after 及賈庶人死 in the same Yongkang-1 sequence (AD 300). Keep his AD 300 hint on the earlier compounding, not on this death.
